name: no-url-plain-text
input: just a sentence with no links at all
expected: just a sentence with no links at all
note: findUrls() finds nothing, so untrack() returns the text unchanged without running any rule.

name: no-url-email-address
note: AUTOLINK_WEB_URL matches only 'example.com' here, and Linkify.sUrlMatchFilter rejects a match immediately preceded by '@', so no URL is untracked.

name: no-change-no-query
note: Common analytics/ads still run and rebuild the query, but there is none, so the URI is byte-identical.

name: no-change-clean-query
note: No key matches '[isu]tm_.*|ref' or the ads pattern; decode+re-encode is the identity for already-canonical values.

name: no-change-root-path
note: Empty query: clearQuery() then nothing appended leaves no '?'.

name: no-change-schemeless-bare-host
note: No scheme, so 'http://' is prepended for processing and removePrefix("http://") strips it again on the way out.

name: no-change-ftp-skipped
note: AUTOLINK_WEB_URL has no ftp:// branch and the protocol-less branch excludes matches preceded by '://', so nothing matches at all.

name: no-change-rtsp-skipped
note: rtsp:// does match AUTOLINK_WEB_URL, but findUrls() drops matches fully matching '(rtsp|ftp)://.*'.

name: no-change-www-twitter-host-anchoring
note: The X rule's host pattern '(twitter|x)\.com' is a FULL match, so 'www.twitter.com' does not match and the query survives (only the analytics/ads rebuild happens, which is a no-op here).

name: no-change-bilibili-bare-host
note: '.+\.bilibili\.com' requires at least one label plus a dot, so the bare apex host is not matched by the Bilibili rules.

name: no-change-amazon-apex-host
note: Amazon's host pattern '.+\.amazon\.(...)' does not match the apex host, so the /ref= path is left alone.

name: no-change-youtube-clean-params
note: retainQueryParameters('index|list|t|v') keeps both keys in their original order.

name: no-change-google-search-clean
note: q is retained by the Google rule, so nothing is removed.

name: analytics-and-ads-multi-param
note: Common analytics removes utm_source (pattern '[isu]tm_.*|ref'); Common ads then removes fbclid, leaving id. Rules run in order and each rebuild is cumulative.

name: analytics-removes-ref
note: 'ref' is removed by the analytics rule (full-match key regex).

name: ads-removes-gclid-wbraid
note: '(fb|g|tt|wicked|y)cl(id|source|src)|[gw]braid' removes gclid and wbraid; keep is untouched.

name: only-tracking-params-query-dropped
note: All parameters are removed, so the rebuilt URI has no query component at all and the '?' disappears.

name: multi-param-order-preserved
note: Removal preserves the relative order of surviving parameters (analytics drops utm_source, then ads drops fbclid).

name: literal-plus-becomes-percent2B
note: removeQueryParameters uses Uri.decode with convertPlus=false, so a literal '+' decodes to '+' and Uri.encode then writes '%2B' ('+' is not in the unreserved set '_-!.~\'()*').

name: percent2B-roundtrips
note: A pre-encoded %2B decodes to '+' and re-encodes to %2B, so this is a no-op - unlike case 'literal-plus-becomes-percent2B'.

name: percent20-roundtrips
note: '%20' decodes to a space and Uri.encode writes a space back as '%20' (never as '+').

name: lowercase-hex-normalised
note: Escapes are decoded to UTF-8 and re-encoded with uppercase hex digits.

name: encoded-unreserved-char-decoded
note: '%41' decodes to 'A', which is unreserved, so it is written back literally.

name: encoded-parens-decoded
note: Parentheses are in Uri.encode's allowed set '_-!.~\'()*', so %28/%29 become literal '(' and ')'.

name: unicode-percent-encoded-decoded
note: CJK is decoded to characters and re-encoded as UTF-8 percent escapes; utm_source is removed.

name: unicode-raw-cjk-encoded
note: Raw non-ASCII in the query survives findUrls() (UCS_CHAR includes CJK) and java.net.URI.normalize(); the query rebuild then percent-encodes it.

name: duplicate-keys-both-kept
note: The parameter walker is a list, not a map, so duplicate keys are kept in order.

name: empty-query-becomes-equals
note: encodedQuery is "" (not null) for a bare '?'; the walker yields one ("","") pair which is not removed, and appendQueryParameter emits "=".

name: bare-key-gains-equals
note: A parameter without '=' yields value "" and is rebuilt as 'a='.

name: key-with-empty-value-unchanged
note: 'a=' also yields value "" and is rebuilt identically.

name: trailing-ampersand-produces-empty-pair
note: The final segment after '&' is processed as a ("","") pair, which is retained and rebuilt as '&='.

name: douban-clears-query-keeps-fragment
note: setEncodedQuery(url, null) drops the query component but leaves the fragment untouched.

name: dot-segments-normalised
note: findUrls() applies java.net.URI.normalize() before any rule runs, then utm_source is removed.

name: host-case-preserved
note: matches() is case-insensitive, but Uri keeps the original authority bytes, so the host case survives the rebuild.

name: scheme-case-preserved
note: findUrls() accepts https?:// case-insensitively and Uri keeps the scheme as given; the query is then cleared.

name: two-urls-in-prose
input: first https://a.example.com/x?utm_source=1 and second https://b.example.com/y?utm_source=2 end
expected: first https://a.example.com/x and second https://b.example.com/y end
note: Every detected URL is untracked in place; replacements are applied from the end of the text so earlier offsets stay valid.

name: one-url-in-prose
note: Only the URL span is replaced; the surrounding prose is preserved.

name: redirect-douban-link2
note: Common redirections matches host+path+both ".*\burl=.+", then RETURNS getQueryParameter('url') as the new URL text (fully decoded) instead of modifying the URI.

name: redirect-douban-link2-schemeless-input
note: No scheme in the text: 'http://' is added for processing, but the rule returns an https:// URL so removePrefix("http://") changes nothing - the output gains a scheme.

name: redirect-zhihu-link
note: Third branch of Common redirections: returns the decoded 'target' parameter.

name: redirect-search-app
note: Second branch of Common redirections: host 'search.app', path '/', query '.*\blink=.+', returns the decoded 'link' parameter. The short-link rule afterwards sees a plain example.com URL and does not fetch.

name: redirect-uppercase-key-not-found
note: The query PATTERN is applied case-insensitively (so 'URL=' satisfies '.*\burl=.+'), but getQueryParameter('url') compares the key case-sensitively and returns null; the rule therefore leaves the URL and the Douban rule then clears the query.

name: redirect-plus-in-value-stays-plus
note: getQueryParameter decodes with convertPlus=true, but a %2B escape stays '+'; the subsequent query rebuild re-encodes it as %2B.

name: redirect-literal-plus-becomes-space
note: getQueryParameter decodes with convertPlus=true, so a LITERAL '+' inside the value becomes a space; the next rule's rebuild encodes that space as %20.

name: redirect-target-fragment-preserved
note: The redirect value may itself carry a fragment; it is returned verbatim after decoding and the query rebuild leaves it alone.

name: google-search-retain
note: retainQueryParameters('q|tbm') keeps q and tbm and drops sca_esv, preserving order.

name: google-search-path-anchoring
note: The path pattern '/search' must match the WHOLE encoded path, so '/search/' does not trigger the Google rule and sca_esv survives (analytics/ads do not remove it).

name: amazon-strip-ref-and-query
note: Amazon clears the query first, then strips a trailing '/ref=...' path segment (lookbehind '(?<=\/)ref=.+$', case-insensitive).

name: amazon-strip-ref-root
note: Path '/ref=nav_logo' becomes '/' after stripping the ref segment.

name: amazon-strip-ref-case-insensitive
note: The ref-strip regex uses the /i flag, so 'Ref=' is stripped too.

name: bilibili-retain-and-drop-p1
note: Bilibili retains business_id|business_type|itemsId|lottery_id|p|start_progress|t (dropping vd_source), then removeQueryParameters('p','1') drops p only because its value fully matches '1'.

name: bilibili-retain-p2
note: Same rules, but p=2 survives because the value pattern '1' is a full-match and '2' != '1'.

name: bilibili-bv-rule-disabled-by-default
note: The BV->av rule has enabled=false upstream, so the default rule set leaves the path as BV. The Bilibili rule runs but there is no query to change.

name: bilibili-bv-to-av-170001
note: ruleIds here means 'run only this rule' (it is disabled upstream), which is how the BV algorithm can still be covered. bvCode='17x411w7KC'; swaps (1,7) and (2,5), drop index 0, base-58 fold over 'FcwAPNKTMug3GV5Lj7EJnHpWsx4tb8haYeviqBz6rkCy12mUSDQX9RdoZf' gives tmp such that (tmp & 2^51-1) ^ 23442827791579 == 170001; the rule then sets path '/video/av170001/' (note the new trailing slash).

name: bilibili-bv-to-av-2
note: Second hand-computed vector: the fold yields exactly XOR_CODE-2, so (tmp & MASK) ^ XOR_CODE == 2. This also pins down the XOR salt: the rule is not a plain base-58 decode.

name: bilibili-bv-to-av-trailing-slash
note: The path pattern allows an optional trailing slash and the BV capture stops at it; the rebuilt path always ends with '/'.

name: bilibili-bv-with-params
note: Run only these two rules, in upstream order: Bilibili retains p=2 (drops vd_source), then BV sets the path with setEncodedPath, which preserves the query.

name: pinterest-strip-sent
note: Pinterest clears the query, then strips a trailing 'sent/' path segment via '(?<=\/)sent\/?$'.

name: pinterest-strip-sent-no-slash
note: Same strip with the optional trailing slash absent: 'sent' is removed, leaving the directory slash.

name: reddit-retain-context
note: analytics removes utm_source first; retainQueryParameters('context') then keeps only context.

name: old-reddit-sethost
note: ruleIds = run only this rule (enabled=false upstream). setHost replaces the authority, keeping path, query and fragment.

name: old-reddit-sethost-keeps-port
note: setHost rebuilds the authority as [encodedUserInfo@]encode(host)[:port]; a non-default port survives.

name: old-reddit-video-path
note: setHost then setEncodedPath('/video' + getEncodedPath(original url)) - the path is read from the ORIGINAL argument, not from the host-rewritten URL.

name: threads-remove-slof-xmt
note: removeQueryParameters('slof|xmt') drops those two keys and keeps the rest.

name: x-clear-query
note: The X rule clears the whole query for the apex host 'x.com'.

name: spotify-clear-query
note: '(open\.)?spotify\.com' full-matches 'open.spotify.com'; the query is cleared.

name: taobao-retain-id
note: analytics drops utm_source, then Taobao's retainQueryParameters('id') drops spm.

name: jd-retain-wareid
note: JD retains id|shopId|skuIds|suitId|wareId; keys are matched case-sensitively as written in the query, so 'wareId' matches the pattern 'wareId'.

name: rednote-retain-xsec-token
note: rednote retains only xsec_token; utm_source is already gone after analytics.

name: netease-retain-id
note: NetEase Cloud Music retains only 'id'.

name: netflix-clear-query
note: Netflix clears the query component.

name: instagram-clear-query
note: Instagram clears the query component.

name: douyin-clear-query
note: Douyin clears the query component.

name: smzdm-clear-query
note: SMZDM clears the query component.

name: tiktok-clear-query
note: TikTok clears the query component.

name: kuaishou-clear-query
note: Kuaishou clears the query component for '.+\.kuaishou\.com'.

name: stackexchange-strip-answer-id
note: Path must fully match '/[aq]/[0-9]+/[0-9]+/?'; the trailing '/<number>' is then stripped by replace(/\/[0-9]+\/?$/).

name: youtube-retain-on-short-host
note: youtu.be matches the YouTube host alternation; retainQueryParameters('index|list|t|v') keeps t=42 and drops si.
